fullForm.en: Signs/Symptoms, Allergies, Medications, Pertinent medical history, Last oral intake, Events leading to injury/illness
fullForm.tl: Signs/Symptoms, Allergies, Medications, Pertinent medical history, Last oral intake, Events leading to injury/illness

description.en: A mnemonic used during patient assessment to gather medical history and current condition information.
description.tl: Isang mnemonic na ginagamit sa panahon ng patient assessment upang makolekta ang medical history at current condition information.

usage.en: Used in patient interviews and assessments to systematically gather relevant medical information.
usage.tl: Ginagamit sa patient interviews at assessments upang sistematikong makolekta ang relevant medical information.

fullForm.en: Onset, Provocation/Palliation, Quality, Radiation, Severity, Time
fullForm.tl: Onset, Provocation/Palliation, Quality, Radiation, Severity, Time

description.en: A mnemonic for assessing pain characteristics during patient evaluation.
description.tl: Isang mnemonic para sa pag-assess ng pain characteristics sa panahon ng patient evaluation.

usage.en: Used to systematically evaluate pain complaints by asking about when it started, what triggers it, how it feels, where it radiates, how severe it is, and how long it lasts.
usage.tl: Ginagamit upang sistematikong suriin ang pain complaints sa pamamagitan ng pagtanong tungkol sa kung kailan ito nagsimula, ano ang nag-trigger, paano ito ramdam, saan ito umiikot, gaano kalakas ito, at gaano katagal ito tumatagal.

description.en: A scale used to assess level of consciousness in patients.
description.tl: Isang scale na ginagamit upang suriin ang level of consciousness sa mga patients.

usage.en: Alert: Patient is awake and oriented. Verbal: Patient responds to verbal stimuli. Painful: Patient responds only to pain. Unresponsive: No response to any stimuli.
usage.tl: Alert: Ang patient ay gising at oriented. Verbal: Ang patient ay tumutugon sa verbal stimuli. Painful: Ang patient ay tumutugon lamang sa pain. Unresponsive: Walang response sa anumang stimuli.

fullForm.en: Deformities, Contusions, Abrasions, Punctures/Penetrations-Burns, Tenderness, Lacerations, Swelling
fullForm.tl: Deformities, Contusions, Abrasions, Punctures/Penetrations-Burns, Tenderness, Lacerations, Swelling

description.en: A systematic approach for trauma assessment, checking for injuries and abnormalities.
description.tl: Isang systematic approach para sa trauma assessment, sumusuri para sa injuries at abnormalities.

usage.en: Used during physical examination of trauma patients to identify signs of injury across the body.
usage.tl: Ginagamit sa panahon ng physical examination ng trauma patients upang matukoy ang signs ng injury sa buong katawan.

description.en: Emergency procedure consisting of chest compressions and rescue breaths to revive a person in cardiac arrest.
description.tl: Emergency procedure na binubuo ng chest compressions at rescue breaths upang ipagbunga ng buhay ang isang taong nasa cardiac arrest.

usage.en: Performed on patients in cardiac arrest to maintain circulation and oxygenation until advanced medical care is available.
usage.tl: Ginagawa sa patients na nasa cardiac arrest upang mapanatili ang circulation at oxygenation hanggang sa available ang advanced medical care.

description.en: A portable electronic device that analyzes heart rhythm and delivers electrical shock to restore normal heart rate.
description.tl: Isang portable electronic device na nag-analyze ng heart rhythm at naghahatid ng electrical shock upang ibalik ang normal na heart rate.

usage.en: Used for patients in ventricular fibrillation or pulseless ventricular tachycardia to attempt defibrillation and restore circulation.
usage.tl: Ginagamit para sa patients na nasa ventricular fibrillation o pulseless ventricular tachycardia upang subukan ang defibrillation at ibalik ang circulation.

description.en: Emergency care provided to maintain airway, breathing, and circulation in a patient experiencing cardiopulmonary arrest.
description.tl: Emergency care na ibinibigay upang mapanatili ang airway, breathing, at circulation sa isang patient na nakakaranas ng cardiopulmonary arrest.

usage.en: First line of care in cardiac and respiratory emergencies, including CPR and use of AED.
usage.tl: First line ng pag-aalaga sa cardiac at respiratory emergencies, kasama ang CPR at paggamit ng AED.

description.en: Advanced medical care including medications, advanced airway management, and cardiac monitoring.
description.tl: Advanced medical care kasama ang medications, advanced airway management, at cardiac monitoring.

usage.en: Provided by paramedics and higher-level providers to stabilize and transport critically ill or injured patients.
usage.tl: Ibinibigay ng paramedics at higher-level providers upang i-stabilize at dalhin ang critically ill o injured patients.

description.en: Protective equipment worn to minimize exposure to bloodborne pathogens and other hazards.
description.tl: Protective equipment na sinaot upang mabawasan ang exposure sa bloodborne pathogens at iba pang hazards.

usage.en: Used during patient contact, especially when exposure to blood or body fluids is anticipated.
usage.tl: Ginagamit sa panahon ng patient contact, lalo na kapag inaasahang may exposure sa blood o body fluids.

description.en: A neurological scale that measures level of consciousness on a scale of 3 to 15 based on eye opening, verbal response, and motor response.
description.tl: Isang neurological scale na susukat ang level of consciousness sa isang scale ng 3 hanggang 15 batay sa eye opening, verbal response, at motor response.

usage.en: Used to assess and communicate severity of brain injury or altered mental status in patients.
usage.tl: Ginagamit upang suriin at makipag-communicate ang severity ng brain injury o altered mental status sa mga patients.
